top3.headline: Anthropic's Q3 revenue hit about $17B as growth slowed to 47%
top3.whyItMatters: Anthropic's growth is cooling while it carries about $895B in compute commitments, a risk Claude buyers should track.

top3.headline: Abu Dhabi puts government rules into AI-readable form with OpenAI
top3.whyItMatters: A live food-import pilot shows AI compliance checks running with traceable rules and human sign-off.

top3.headline: US Census renames AI as 'Super Intelligence' in its business survey
top3.whyItMatters: About 40% of large US firms report using AI, but changing wording makes the trend hard to compare.

items.title: a16z: 94% of enterprise LLM buyers expect to spend more
items.takeaway: Three rules for AI apps to beat in-house builds: run the workflow, rent context cheaply, price on proven value.
items.soWhat: Before building AI tools in-house, test vendors that can prove they run the workflow better than you.

items.title: OpenAI unveils LifeVal, a benchmark for everyday assistant tasks
items.takeaway: Built from ChatGPT user feedback on tasks like childcare, government services and personal finances.
items.soWhat: OpenAI is grading models on everyday life tasks, a sign consumer assistants will compete on errands.

items.title: Meng To designs in Figma Weave, then Claude Code builds it
items.takeaway: One canvas makes a frame in four seasons, depth maps and motion studies; he shared the workflow.
items.soWhat: Designers can hand a finished visual folder to a coding agent, shortening the design-to-build handoff.

items.title: YC: Blacksmith grew 20x as testing becomes AI coding's bottleneck
items.takeaway: The faster CI cloud raised a $66M Series C at a $1B valuation, per YC, with a team of 30.
items.soWhat: As AI writes more code, budget for faster testing, or CI will cap how fast you deliver.

items.title: Anthropic's amended S-1 shows $17B Q3 revenue, growth slowing
items.takeaway: Q3 revenue rose 47% on Q2, down from 144%; about $895.4B committed, mostly to compute.
items.soWhat: If Claude is core to your stack, note its maker carries about $895B in compute commitments.

items.title: Census survey now asks firms about 'Super Intelligence,' not AI
items.takeaway: Large-firm AI use near 40% in October under new wording; question renamed under Executive Order 14434.
items.soWhat: Official AI adoption numbers keep changing definitions, so compare trend lines carefully before citing them.

items.title: Abu Dhabi signs four OpenAI deals, including machine-readable rules
items.takeaway: First pilot checks food imports against AI-readable rules; officials keep final decisions.
items.soWhat: AI rule-checking is moving into live government services, with every assessment traced to a rule.

items.title: Trigger.dev says an attacker accessed some customers' environment variables
items.takeaway: Exploit blocked; impacted account owners were emailed mitigation steps.
items.soWhat: If your team uses Trigger.dev, check for its email and rotate any secrets stored there.

voices.quote: Model progress continually improves the customer's alternative. Your advantage must widen faster for the application to keep earning its premium.
